question: Find the value of ({frac{2)/(5) of 7(1)/(2) div (3)/(4) - (3)/(4) times 1(1)/(2) div 2(1)/(4)}}{{5(1)/(2) div 3(2)/(3) of (3)/(8)_{}^{}}};
solution:
**Given:**

(frac{2)/(5) of 7(1)/(2) ÷ (3)/(4) - (3)/(4) × 1(1)/(2) ÷ 2(1)/(4)}{5(1)/(2) ÷ 3(2)/(3) of (3)/(8)}

**Concept used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the given table

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/jPa44KB-TaKrcbLZbdXPHOKf_MnnSkQITy0LdtYB74QRObRQXmWKXHsl6V2x55hq9YYYlsS_sfuzfv1n8dra_6so1mW4M4dBo55OwQLGcnBx5FiBPZ7oVZruXlBjnJ0sE8nU1Ouo5bjBanMQCFVLbA] 

**Calculation:**

(2/5 of 7(1)/(2) ÷ 3/4 - 3/4 × 1(1)/(2) ÷ 2(1)/(4))/(5(1)/(2) ÷ 3(2)/(3) of 3/8)

⇒ (2/5 of 15/2 ÷ 3/4 - 3/4 × 3/2 ÷ 9/4)/(11/2 ÷ 11/3 of 3/8)

⇒ (3 ÷ 3/4 - 3/4 × 3/2 ÷ 9/4)/(11/2 ÷ 11/8)

⇒ (4 - 3/4 × 2/3)/4

⇒ (4 - 1/2)/4

⇒ (8 - 1)/(2 × 4)

⇒ 7/(2 × 4)

⇒ 7/8

**∴ The value of the given fraction is 7/8**​
